description: This file defines a custom hook/useDiagnostics for performing diagnostic API calls related to installer and upgrader start events in the OrangeHRM system. It exports a function that takes an APIService instance and returns two methods to trigger these events via POST requests.

methods.name: export default function useDiagnostics(http: APIService) { useDiagnostics
methods.description: A function that accepts an APIService instance and returns an object with methods to send diagnostic start notifications for installer and upgrader.

methods.name: notifyInstallerStart
methods.description: Sends a POST request to the /installer/api/send-data/installer-start endpoint to notify that the installer has started.

methods.name: notifyUpgraderStart
methods.description: Sends a POST request to the /installer/api/send-data/upgrader-start endpoint to notify that the upgrader has started.
